{"scratch": "counter_k1: High persistence for Marisol/Nico tech (phones, chargers) and shared items (dog_leash, water_bottles). Talia's lunchbox appears here. Resident presence boosts prob of their specific items to 0.80-0.90. By 10:00, mugs drop <0.10; pens/pots appear.

desk_b3: Transient drop zone, not stable storage. Items (lunchbox, headphones) move quickly to counter or ON_PERSON. Empty when resident present implies items are elsewhere. d09: Confirmed as transient spot for shared items (bowl_shared_1) when resident_3 present. Raise shared item prob to 0.30-0.40; lower headphones_nico to 0.05.

bedroom_floor_b3: Valid transient spot for personal items (headphones, hairbrush) when resident_3 is present. Low prob for loose gear if resident absent. d09: Confirmed stable spot for headphones_nico (p>0.60) even when resident is in room. Empty room does not imply empty floor for loose items.

bed_b3: Low probability (<0.05) for Nico's personal gear; items are not stored in bed.

nightstand_b1: Stable spot for Marisol's glasses (p>0.80). Not for tech, meds, or keys. d08: book_marisol absent (p<0.10); likely in living/kitchen or ON_PERSON. Nightstand holds only glasses/meds for Marisol.

cupboard_k1: Primary location for keys_nico, especially when resident_3 is present (prob 0.45-0.60). Low probability (<0.10) for plates or cookware; these belong in sink.

sink_k1: Primary storage for shared cookware (pans, pots, plates, bowls). High persistence even when unoccupied. d08: Confirmed storage for bowl_shared_1, lunchbox_talia, pan_shared_1, plate_shared_1, pot_shared_1. Mug_marisol absent (p<0.10).

General: Resident presence dictates item location. If resident in bedroom, raise prob for personal items in bed/nightstand only if resting. Common areas dominate daytime activity.

ON_PERSON: Marisol carries phone_marisol (p>0.80); keys/wallet absent. Nico carries nothing when in bedroom_3 (phone_nico <0.10); phone likely in desk/nightstand.

nightstand_b3: Empty; not a storage spot for Nico's items (phone, keys, wallet, headphones). All p<0.05. Nico's gear remains on bedroom_floor_b3 or desk_b3.

d09 Wed 00:00: d09 Wed 00:00: desk_b3: bowl_shared_1; resident_3 present. Confirms desk_b3 as transient drop zone for shared items (bowl) and resident_3. My forecast missed bowl_shared_1 (p~0.05) and over-predicted headphones_nico (0.15). Adjust: raise shared item prob at desk_b3 to 0.30-0.40 when resident_3 present; lower headphones_nico to 0.05. Resident presence boosts shared item likelihood at desks."}
